name: The Monopolist
description: You inherit a modest beverage operation and a mandate: build a dominant, profitable, globally-famous soft-drink empire. Beat the domestic market leader FizzCorp on brand, export enough volume to fund the expansion, and hold the balance sheet in the black for two full years running. A tycoon doesn't just win — they win consistently.

goals.description: Reach 70 brand awareness for soft drink in Metropolis — become the household name.
Bank $8M in cumulative export revenue — the world market funds the war chest.
Post 24 consecutive months of positive net income — tycoons don't just spike, they compound.
Grow corporate value to $50M — capstone on a finished empire.
